name: Alchemist
ability: You have a Minion ability. When using this, the Storyteller may prompt you to choose differently.
setup: The Storyteller picks a not-in-play Minion; the Alchemist holds that Minion's ability. Setup effects of that ability (e.g. Baron +2 Outsiders) apply.
wakes: First night (order 3) to learn which Minion ability they have; afterwards whenever that Minion would wake.
interaction: First night: shown YOU ARE and the Minion token. Thereafter uses the Minion ability as that Minion would; if the ability makes a choice, the Storyteller may require a different choice and the Alchemist must comply.
drunk_or_poisoned: The gained Minion ability does not work (no effect; false info if it gives info). Setup effects already applied remain.

jinxes.text: An Alchemist-Marionette has no Marionette ability & the Marionette is in play.
An Alchemist-Mastermind has no Mastermind ability & the Mastermind is not-in-play.
An Alchemist-Spy has no Spy ability & a Spy is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Spy may publicly guess a living player as the Spy. If correct, the Demon must choose the Spy tonight.

An Alchemist-Widow has no Widow ability & a Widow is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Widow may publicly guess a living player as the Widow. If correct, the Demon must choose the Widow tonight.

rulings.text: The Alchemist is good, registers as good, does not wake with the Minions and does not learn the Demon.
The Minion ability given is one that is not in play.
The Storyteller may prompt a different choice (at night by gesturing at the ability text); e.g. an Alchemist-Poisoner choosing a dangerous target is asked to choose again and must.
Older role data reads 'You have a not-in-play Minion ability.'; the current wiki text is used here.
Night order numbers are from the bra1n townsquare roles.json; 0 there is recorded as null.

test_scenarios.name: alchemist-poisoner
test_scenarios.setup: Seat 1 Alchemist (Poisoner ability), seat 2 Imp, seat 3 Baron, seat 4 Empath, seat 5 Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alchemist is shown Poisoner and chooses seat 4. Night 2: Empath wakes.
test_scenarios.expected: Seat 4 is poisoned and may get false info; the Alchemist still registers good.

test_scenarios.name: alchemist-baron-setup
test_scenarios.setup: 7 players; Alchemist given the Baron ability; no Baron in play.
test_scenarios.expected: Two extra Outsiders are in the bag; the Alchemist is good.

test_scenarios.name: storyteller-redirects
test_scenarios.expected: The Storyteller asks them to choose again; the Imp is not poisoned and the new choice is.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned-alchemist
test_scenarios.setup: Alchemist-Poisoner whose neighbour No Dashii poisons them; Empath.
test_scenarios.expected: The Empath is not poisoned; the choice has no effect.

test_scenarios.name: alchemist-spy-jinx
test_scenarios.actions: After an execution the living Alchemist publicly guesses the Spy correctly.
test_scenarios.expected: The Alchemist has no Spy ability; the Imp must choose the Spy tonight.
